cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Close It Properly
cards.instruction: Keep them present until both of you complete the ritual that formally ends this role, meeting, or relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you leave book club, we close the discussion together. I'll give the closing line; you answer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said goodnight. My taxi's coming. Can we count that?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not as the close. I'll say 'chapter closed'; you say 'until next time.' Then you're free to go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's here. Can I say my bit from the car?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can, with the window down. I'll come beside you and give the line. Ten seconds; once you've answered, I release you to whatever the driver wants to discuss.

reason: Make A decide which proposed closure counts and permit B car solution with a finite mutual ritual. Use the driver wording after an unchanged guard rejected a substring before candidate write.
